newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli officer killed in south Lebanon -army.
newsitem.headline: Israeli officer killed in south Lebanon -army.

text.p: An Israeli officer was killed by a mortar bomb in south Lebanon on Friday, the army said on Saturday.

It said the officer was part of a force on "operational duty" inside the occupation zone Israel controls north of its border and that he was seriously wounded during heavy mortar bombardments of Israeli positions. He later died in an Israeli hospital.
Pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrillas, fighting to oust Israeli forces from south Lebanon, frequently attack Israeli soldiers and pro-Israeli South Lebanon Army militiamen.
